programme.title: Belle and the Beast
programme.desc: Eric Landry is a cold-hearted man that people have nicknamed "the Beast." Years of anger and bitterness have consumed him, turning him into a selfish man. But Belle Watson is the exact opposite. When her father accidentally breaks a valuable work of art at the Landry mansion, Belles agrees to work for Eric in an effort to repay him and save her father's job. She discovers there just might be more to Eric. Will she find the man within the Beast?

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Looking for Dr. Love
programme.desc: Recently divorced hairstylist, Jenny, on a mission to reconnect with Liam, her college sweetheart, is shocked to learn that he is "Dr. Love", the DJ she listens to on the radio. As the couple’s relationship slowly reignites, Jenny discovers that Liam is already engaged. Will Jenny’s heart break a second time, or can true love prevail?

programme.title: Three Dates To Forever
programme.desc: Maddie Mckenzie is a hard-working presenter whose drive and talent has made her a popular radio host. John Reed is a carefree tech entrepreneur who's more interested in hosting parties. The two couldn't be more different.

programme.title: Love by Accident
programme.desc: After breaking down on a road trip with her godmother, a woman enlists her mechanic to be her fake boyfriend, but soon their fake relationship isn't so fake after all.

programme.title: Beauty and the Billionaire: Bali
programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan’s trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan’s lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he’s well.

programme.title: Best Friend from Heaven
programme.desc: When a tragic accident takes the life of their dog, Tara and Pete are forced to indefinitely postpone their wedding. With a little help from above, their small town rallies together to make sure these two are able to have the wedding of their dreams.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.
